rules.title: Just Cause Eviction Ordinance
rules.requirement: After 30 days of tenancy, a landlord must have a legally valid reason (just cause) to terminate a tenancy, stated in a written notice; no-fault terminations require relocation assistance or rent waiver.
rules.coverage_conditions: Applies to residential rental properties in Santa Ana not falling within listed exemptions.
rules.exemptions: Housing produced in the last 15 years; deed-restricted affordable housing; hotel and transient occupancy; hospital and care facilities; dormitories; and other shared living quarters.
rules.citation: Santa Ana Just Cause Eviction Ordinance
rules.quoted_span: After 30 days, an owner shall not terminate a tenancy without just cause, which shall be stated in a written notice.

coverage.other_unknown_factor: whether the unit is deed-restricted affordable housing, hotel/transient occupancy, hospital/care facility, dormitory, or shared living quarters

rules.title: Just Cause Eviction Ordinance - no-fault relocation assistance
rules.requirement: If a landlord evicts a tenant for a no-fault reason, the landlord must provide 3 months of relocation assistance or waive the final 3 months of rent.
rules.key_value: 3 months relocation assistance or rent waiver
rules.coverage_conditions: Applies to no-fault just cause terminations under the Just Cause Eviction Ordinance.
rules.exemptions: Housing produced in the last 15 years; deed-restricted affordable housing; hotel and transient occupancy; hospital and care facilities; dormitories; and other shared living quarters.
rules.citation: Santa Ana Just Cause Eviction Ordinance
rules.quoted_span: Under a no-fault just cause termination, the owner shall either provide 3 months of relocation assistance or waive payment of rent for the final 3 months of the tenancy.

coverage.other_unknown_factor: whether the unit is deed-restricted affordable housing, hotel/transient occupancy, hospital/care facility, dormitory, or shared living quarters
